params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dest=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-quota-circuit-test'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch fix/codex-quota-dispatch-circuit-20260929 https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dest; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Push-Location (Join-Path $dest 'tools\agent-control'); try { npm run check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; npm test; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE} } finally { Pop-Location }; git -C $dest diff --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'QUOTA_CIRCUIT_TEST_PASS'
